lookup_cache_scenarios.expected: First well caches ADVERB and ADJECTIVE plus NOUN/VERB/INTERJECTION; indexes better→well/ADV (+ well/ADJ). Before better first lookup, better.discoveryCompletedAt=null. First better finds good/ADJ and independent better/ADJ,NOUN,VERB. Second better uses stored discovery.
good/ADJ populates better→good/ADJ; better discovery remains incomplete until better itself is searched; discovering better adds well and independent better meanings.
better search fetches full well dictionary entry; direct later well search sees independent well/NOUN and well/VERB as cached facts, but well.discoveryCompletedAt is not inferred solely from fetch.
poised/ADJ meanings plus poised→poise/VERB past+participle; fetch poise saves BOTH poise/NOUN and poise/VERB definitions. poise/NOUN is not a form interpretation of poised.
Caching poise/VERB builds poised form mapping without proving poised standalone adjective; first poised lookup still fetches its literal dictionary page.
All validated NOUN and VERB targets survive; axis/NOUN and axe/NOUN/VERB are cached by their full entries; no Word(axes) solely from inflection references.
children morphological references do not create Word(children) or Definition(children); child/NOUN becomes validated; childer/NOUN remains only a candidate until independently validated.
Child-first generates children→child/NOUN mapping but does not make children.discoveryCompletedAt non-null; children lookup inspects additional childer reference.
Independent saw/NOUN and saw/VERB plus see/VERB past and past-participle retained after first lookup; POS context must not alter permanently cached set.
Independent found/NOUN and found/VERB plus find/VERB inflection retained; no spurious found=only find.
Run/VERB and meet/VERB participial references retained alongside independent running/ADJ,NOUN (and observed ADV/PREPOSITION) and meeting/NOUN. No form-of text stored as Definition.
If better→well/ADV preexists but better.discoveryCompletedAt is null, run first-time discovery instead of returning only well.
Preexisting Word + Definition does not imply successful exact dictionary fetch or completed surface discovery; finish safely and deduplicate.
A candidate fetched as a dependency has its own dictionaryFetchedAt, but discoveryCompletedAt remains null until that spelling is selected and fully processed.
Fake term qzvxnotaword receives 404; mark fetched for exact surface, no Word/Definition, no re-fetch on repeat completed lookup.
HTTP 503/timeouts do not set dictionaryFetchedAt or discoveryCompletedAt for incomplete work; retry can finish.
Surface processed and fetched timestamp set; dependency failure keeps original discovery incomplete; retry reuses safe cached work.
Unresolved marked reference never becomes a trusted WordForm or semantic definition; completion tracks successful conservative processing, not universal certainty.
No duplicate Word, Definition, WordForm, LookupState; final completion truthful; repeated provider request during race allowed.
BETTER / Better / better normalize to same English term and relationship rows, while card context preserves original characters.
spaCy selected noun or verb does not suppress independent POS or morphological candidates; presentation ranking may differ, stored set identical.
saw→see/VERB has both past and past_participle; walked→walk/VERB from morphology has past and possibly participle ONLY with actual evidence; no uniqueness collapse.
axes maps to axe, ax, axis NOUN and ax/axe VERB; better maps to good/ADJ and well/ADJ/ADV, with independent better lexical meanings.
better→bettor/NOUN alias is candidate link; do not duplicate bettor senses under better or convert alias to inflection card.
Symbol in captured axe and saw responses does not create a Languee POS mapping or corrupt other supported senses.

schema_and_card_scenarios.expected: Prisma Definition no longer has inflectionForms or hasIrregularForms, and obsolete compound index is gone.
Unique (wordId,form,POS,relationType); multiple forms/targets and distinct grammatical types permitted.
Unique (term,language); independent dictionaryFetchedAt and discoveryCompletedAt; negative lookup permitted.
Every Definition for good or well may be different POS; only correct Word+POS gets its morphology at service boundary.
Migration preserves existing Word IDs, Definition IDs, foreign keys from Card, deck membership, review logs, export state.
Card.inflectionForms is retained and existing snapshots remain byte-for-byte stable unless user actions already require a change.
New card for go/VERB uses go forms, not selected surface forms and not WordForm alternative_spelling rows.
A card for well/NOUN never tests better/best, which belong to well/ADV/ADJ.
go/VERB, child/NOUN, good/ADJ, well/ADV irregular; walk/VERB regular; poise/VERB regular; no false irregular inflection card for regular or noun well.
Card creation, review queue, typed answer checks, masking, and Anki export all continue using snapshots/derived paradigms.
No breaking changes to existing public vocabulary lookup DTO; internal discovery retains all headword+POS identities.
Old Word with no LookupState is rediscovered safely without losing definitions or creating duplicates.

gold_source_note: Dictionary gold references and independent API record counts are from attached gold.json/results.json. Holdout independent observations come from results.json, not a manually scored gold set; raw Wiktionary HTML payloads must be frozen for parser integration tests. The additional parser/cache/schema/context cases are controlled fixtures/expected application invariants. The M* cases are unambiguous standard-English examples supplied as controlled provider fixtures; they do not assert LemmInflect coverage or live Wiktionary output.
